description: Benchmarks the charge-symmetric strong bond + separate Coulomb light-nuclei binding vs AME (the #3564/#3570 diagnosis payoff). Charge-symm (all bonds = isoscalar f_pn) minus canonical Coulomb FIXES the ³H/³He mirror split — collapses to 1.00 MeV (Coulomb) from the broken kernel's 2.27–3.27 MeV vs AME 0.76 (~3× gain), exactly as predicted. Absolute binding NOT closed (D over-, ⁴He under-bound) — the edge-set/E₀/connected magnitude (#3548's connected-(2,1)/SU(4) mechanism, still on the charge-breaking kernel) must be re-run charge-symmetric. Verified split win, not a closure. Scope-(a), no wiring.
